                                    <Button Content="Select All" Click="SelectAllTags_Click" Padding="6,2" FontSize="11"/>
                                    <Button Content="Clear" Click="ClearTags_Click" Padding="6,2" FontSize="11" Margin="6,0,0,0"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TagCountText" DockPanel.Dock="Top" Text="0 tag(s)"
                                           Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" Opacity="0.7" FontSize="11" Margin="0,0,0,4"/>
                                <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
                                    <StackPanel x:Name="TagFilterPanel"/>
                                </ScrollViewer>
                            </DockPanel>
                        </Border>

                        <DataGrid x:Name="DownloadedModsGrid" Grid.Column="1">
                            <DataGrid.RowStyle>
                                <Style TargetType="DataGridRow">
                                    <Setter Property="Tag" Value="{Binding}"/>
                                    <Setter Property="ContextMenu" Value="{StaticResource InstalledModsRowContextMenu}"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                            <Setter Property="Background" Value="#1EFFFFFF"/>
                                        </Trigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </DataGrid.RowStyle>
                            <DataGrid.Columns>
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="" Width="42" SortMemberPath="ModName">
                                    <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                        <DataTemplate>
                                            <Grid Width="32" Height="32">
                                                <Border Background="{DynamicResource BgField}" CornerRadius="4"
                                                        BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderCol}" BorderThickness="1">
                                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Initial}" FontSize="14" FontWeight="Bold"
                                                               Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" Opacity="0.45"
                                                               HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                                </Border>
                                                <Image Source="{Binding ThumbnailPath}" Stretch="UniformToFill" Margin="1.5">
                                                    <Image.Style>
                                                        <Style TargetType="Image">
                                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                                            <Style.Triggers>
                                                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding ThumbnailPath}" Value="">
                                                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                                </DataTrigger>
                                                            </Style.Triggers>
                                                        </Style>
                                                    </Image.Style>
                                                </Image>
                                            </Grid>
                                        </DataTemplate>
                                    </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Folder" Binding="{Binding Folder}" Width="2*"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="Mod Name" Binding="{Binding ModName}" Width="3*"/>
                            <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="Status" Width="1.6*" SortMemberPath="StatusLabel">
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                    <DataTemplate>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding StatusLabel}" FontWeight="Bold" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                            <TextBlock.Style>
                                                <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#3EB489"/>
                                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding NeedsUpdate}" Value="True">
                                                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FF8C00"/>
                                                            <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                                                                <BeginStoryboard x:Name="PulseStoryboard">
                                                                    <Storyboard>
                                                                        <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity"
                                                                                         From="1.0" To="0.45"
                                                                                         Duration="0:0:0.9" AutoReverse="True" RepeatBehavior="Forever"/>
                                                                    </Storyboard>
                                                                </BeginStoryboard>
                                                            </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                                                            <DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                                                                <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="PulseStoryboard"/>
                                                            </DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                                </Style>
                                            </TextBlock.Style>
                                        </TextBlock>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                            </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                            <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="Requirements" Width="1.6*" SortMemberPath="RequirementLabel">
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                    <DataTemplate>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding RequirementLabel}" FontWeight="Bold" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                            <TextBlock.Style>
                                                <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#3EB489"/>
                                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasMissingDeps}" Value="True">
                                                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FF8C00"/>
                                                            <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                                                                <BeginStoryboard x:Name="ReqPulseStoryboard">
                                                                    <Storyboard>
                                                                        <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity"
                                                                                         From="1.0" To="0.45"
                                                                                         Duration="0:0:0.9" AutoReverse="True" RepeatBehavior="Forever"/>
                                                                    </Storyboard>
                                                                </BeginStoryboard>
                                                            </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                                                            <DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                                                                <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="ReqPulseStoryboard"/>
                                                            </DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                                </Style>
                                            </TextBlock.Style>
                                        </TextBlock>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                            </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="Tags" Binding="{Binding TagsLabel}" Width="1.4*"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="Size" Binding="{Binding Size}" Width="0.9*"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="Install Date" Binding="{Binding InstallDate}" Width="1.2*"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="Local Version" Binding="{Binding LocalVersion}" Width="1.1*"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="Steam Version" Binding="{Binding SteamVersion}" Width="1.1*"/>
                            <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="" Width="36">
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                    <DataTemplate>
                                        <Button Content="📁" Tag="{Binding FullPath}" Click="OpenFolder_Click"
                                                ToolTip="Open Mod Folder" Width="30" Height="30" Padding="0"
                                                Margin="0" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                FontSize="15"/>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                            </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                            <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="" Width="36">
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                    <DataTemplate>
                                        <Button Content="🔗" Tag="{Binding Id}" Click="ModPage_Click"
                                                ToolTip="Open Mod Page" Width="30" Height="30" Padding="0"
                                                Margin="0" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                FontSize="15"/>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                            </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                            <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="" Width="36">
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                    <DataTemplate>
                                        <Button Content="⬇" Tag="{Binding}" Click="UpdateSingleMod_Click"
                                                ToolTip="Update This Mod" Width="30" Height="30" Padding="0"
                                                Margin="0" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                FontSize="15"
                                                Background="{DynamicResource AccentGreen}" Foreground="White" FontWeight="Bold">
                                            <Button.Style>
                                                <Style TargetType="Button">
                                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding NeedsUpdate}" Value="True">
                                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                                </Style>
                                            </Button.Style>
                                        </Button>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                            </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                            <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="" Width="36">
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                    <DataTemplate>
                                        <Button Content="🔁" Tag="{Binding}" Click="ForceRedownloadMod_Click"
                                                ToolTip="Force Redownload" Width="30" Height="30" Padding="0"
                                                Margin="0" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                FontSize="15"/>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                            </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                            <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="" Width="36">
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                    <DataTemplate>
                                        <Button Content="🗑" Tag="{Binding}" Click="UninstallMod_Click"
                                                ToolTip="Uninstall Mod" Width="30" Height="30" Padding="0"
                                                Margin="0" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                FontSize="15"/>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                            </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                            <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="" Width="36">
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                    <DataTemplate>
                                        <Button Content="⚙" Tag="{Binding}" Click="ShowDeps_Click"
                                                ToolTip="Show Dependencies" Width="30" Height="30" Padding="0"
                                                Margin="0" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                FontSize="15"
                                                Background="{DynamicResource AccentGreen}" Foreground="White" FontWeight="Bold">
                                            <Button.Style>
                                                <Style TargetType="Button">
                                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasDependencies}" Value="True">
                                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                                </Style>
                                            </Button.Style>
                                        </Button>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                            </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                        </DataGrid.Columns>
                    </DataGrid>

                    <!-- Tile view -->
                    <ScrollViewer Grid.Column="1" Visibility="{Binding Visibility, ElementName=InstalledTiles}" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
                        <ItemsControl x:Name="InstalledTiles" Visibility="Collapsed" Margin="0,2,0,0">
                            <ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                                <ItemsPanelTemplate>
                                    <WrapPanel/>
                                </ItemsPanelTemplate>
                            </ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                            <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                <DataTemplate>
                                    <Button Click="ModPage_Click" Tag="{Binding}"
                                            Style="{StaticResource TileButtonStyle}"
                                            ContextMenu="{StaticResource InstalledModsRowContextMenu}"
                                            ToolTip="{Binding ModName}">
                                        <StackPanel>
                                            <ContentControl Content="{Binding}" ContentTemplate="{StaticResource TileThumbnail}"/>
                                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding ModName}" Style="{StaticResource TileNameTextStyle}"/>
                                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding StatusLabel}" Style="{StaticResource TileUpdateStatusText}"/>
                                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding RequirementLabel}" Style="{StaticResource TileRequirementStatusText}"/>
                                        </StackPanel>
                                    </Button>
                                </DataTemplate>
                            </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                        </ItemsControl>
                    </ScrollViewer>
                    </Grid>
                </Grid>
            </TabItem>
            <TabItem Header="Uninstalled Mods">
                <Grid Background="{DynamicResource BgDark}">
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                    <TextBlock Grid.Row="0" Margin="8,8,8,0"

                        <ToggleButton x:Name="UninstalledTilesToggle" Content="▦ Tiles" Tag="Tiles"

                        <Slider Width="140" Minimum="80" Maximum="260" Value="140"
                                ValueChanged="ModTileSize_Changed" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                IsSnapToTickEnabled="True" TickFrequency="10"/>
                    </StackPanel>

                    <Grid Grid.Row="2" Margin="8,0,8,8">
                        <DataGrid x:Name="UninstalledModsGrid">
                            <DataGrid.RowStyle>
                                <Style TargetType="DataGridRow">
                                    <Setter Property="Tag" Value="{Binding}"/>
                                    <Setter Property="ContextMenu" Value="{StaticResource UninstalledModsRowContextMenu}"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                            <Setter Property="Background" Value="#1EFFFFFF"/>
                                        </Trigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </DataGrid.RowStyle>
                            <DataGrid.Columns>
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="" Width="42" SortMemberPath="ModName">

                                        <DataTemplate>
                                            <Grid Width="32" Height="32">
                                                <Border Background="{DynamicResource BgField}" CornerRadius="4"
                                                        BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderCol}" BorderThickness="1">
                                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Initial}" FontSize="14" FontWeight="Bold"

                                                               HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>

                                                <Image Source="{Binding ThumbnailPath}" Stretch="UniformToFill" Margin="1.5">
                                                    <Image.Style>
                                                        <Style TargetType="Image">
                                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                                            <Style.Triggers>
                                                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding ThumbnailPath}" Value="">
                                                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                                </DataTrigger>
                                                            </Style.Triggers>
                                                        </Style>
                                                    </Image.Style>
                                                </Image>
                                            </Grid>
                                        </DataTemplate>
                                    </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>

<ContentControl Content="{Binding}" ContentTemplate="{StaticResource TileThumbnail}"/>
                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding ModName}" Style="{StaticResource TileNameTextStyle}"/>
                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding UninstallDate}" Style="{StaticResource TileStatusTextBase}"
                                                           Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"/>
                                            </StackPanel>
                                        </Button>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                            </ItemsControl>
                        </ScrollViewer>
                    </Grid>
                </Grid>
            </TabItem>

            <!-- ============ SETTINGS TAB ============ -->
            <TabItem Header="Settings">
                <StackPanel Background="{DynamicResource BgDark}" Margin="16">
                    <TextBlock Text="Mods Folder" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"
                               FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,6"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="Where mods are downloaded to and installed for Project Zomboid to find them."
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" Opacity="0.7" TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,24">
                        <TextBox x:Name="PzFolderBox" Width="520" IsReadOnly="True" VerticalContentAlignment="Center"/>
                        <Button Content="Browse..." Click="OpenPzFolder_Click"/>
                    </StackPanel>

                    <TextBlock Text="Options" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"
                               FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,10"/>
                    <CheckBox x:Name="BackupCheckbox" Content="Backup updated mods before overwriting"
                              Checked="SettingsCheckbox_Changed" Unchecked="SettingsCheckbox_Changed" Margin="0,0,0,10"/>
                    <CheckBox x:Name="AutoRefreshCheckbox" Content="Auto-refresh mod list when switching to Installed Mods tab"
                              Checked="SettingsCheckbox_Changed" Unchecked="SettingsCheckbox_Changed" Margin="0,0,0,10"/>
                    <CheckBox x:Name="DebugLoggingCheckbox" Content="Show debug-level messages in the log panel (verbose SteamCMD output)"
                              Checked="SettingsCheckbox_Changed" Unchecked="SettingsCheckbox_Changed" Margin="0,0,0,20"/>

                    <TextBlock Text="Theme" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"
                               FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,10"/>
                    <ComboBox x:Name="ThemeCombo" Width="220" HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                              SelectionChanged="ThemeCombo_SelectionChanged">
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Light"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Dark"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Midnight"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Forest"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Nord"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Dracula"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Solarized Dark"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Solarized Light"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Gruvbox"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Monokai"/>
                    </ComboBox>

                    <TextBlock Text="UI Customization" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"
                               FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,24,0,10"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="Font sizes apply live. Scroll speed multiplies the mouse-wheel step of the tables and lists."
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" Opacity="0.7" TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>

                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                        <TextBlock Text="General text size:" Width="160" Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                        <Slider x:Name="FontGeneralSlider" Width="220" Minimum="10" Maximum="20" TickFrequency="0.5"
                                IsSnapToTickEnabled="True" ValueChanged="UiFontSlider_Changed"/>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="FontGeneralLabel" Text="12.5" Width="50" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                        <TextBlock Text="Buttons:" Width="160" Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                        <Slider x:Name="FontButtonsSlider" Width="220" Minimum="10" Maximum="20" TickFrequency="0.5"
                                IsSnapToTickEnabled="True" ValueChanged="UiFontSlider_Changed"/>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="FontButtonsLabel" Text="12.5" Width="50" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                        <TextBlock Text="Tab headers:" Width="160" Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                        <Slider x:Name="FontTabsSlider" Width="220" Minimum="10" Maximum="20" TickFrequency="0.5"
                                IsSnapToTickEnabled="True" ValueChanged="UiFontSlider_Changed"/>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="FontTabsLabel" Text="13" Width="50" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                        <TextBlock Text="Log panel:" Width="160" Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                        <Slider x:Name="FontLogSlider" Width="220" Minimum="8" Maximum="18" TickFrequency="0.5"
                                IsSnapToTickEnabled="True" ValueChanged="UiFontSlider_Changed"/>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="FontLogLabel" Text="11" Width="50" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    </StackPanel>

                    <Button Content="Reset UI to Defaults" Click="ResetUi_Click" HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                            Padding="16,6" Margin="0,0,0,4"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="Resets the font sizes above. Does not touch the mods folder, theme, or other settings."
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" Opacity="0.7" TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,0,0,20"/>

                    <Button Content="About" Click="AboutButton_Click" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Margin="0,24,0,0" Padding="16,6"/>
                </StackPanel>
            </TabItem>

        </TabControl>

        <!-- ============ QUEUE SIDE PANEL (window-level, right side; auto-shows when mods are queued) ============ -->
        <Border x:Name="QueuePanel" Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="1" Visibility="Collapsed"
                Background="{DynamicResource BgPanel}" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderCol}" BorderThickness="1,0,0,0">
            <DockPanel Margin="6">
                <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Text="Download Queue" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"
                           FontWeight="Bold" Margin="4,4,4,8"/>
                <Button DockPanel.Dock="Top" Content="Start Downloading All" Click="StartQueue_Click"
                        Background="{DynamicResource AccentGreen}" Foreground="White" FontWeight="Bold"/>
                <Button DockPanel.Dock="Top" Content="Clear Queue" Click="ClearQueue_Click"/>
                <ListBox x:Name="QueueList" Background="Transparent" BorderThickness="0" Margin="0,8,0,0">
                    <ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                        <DataTemplate>
                            <StackPanel Margin="0,4">
                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding Title}" Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" TextWrapping="Wrap" FontSize="12"/>
                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding Status}" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}" FontSize="11"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </DataTemplate>
                    </ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                </ListBox>
            </DockPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- ============ BOTTOM LOG / STATUS PANEL (window-level, visible from every tab) ============ -->
        <Border Grid.Row="1" Grid.ColumnSpan="2" Background="{DynamicResource BgPanel}" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderCol}" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0">
            <StackPanel>
                <Grid Margin="8,4">
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="StatusText" Grid.Column="0" Text="Waiting..."
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,10,0"/>
                    <ProgressBar x:Name="ProgressBarCtl" Grid.Column="1" Height="14" IsIndeterminate="False"/>
                    <ToggleButton x:Name="LogToggle" Grid.Column="2" Content="Show Log ▲" Click="ToggleLog_Click"
                                  Margin="10,0,0,0" Padding="8,3"/>
                </Grid>
                <Border x:Name="LogPanelBorder" Height="0" ClipToBounds="True" Background="{DynamicResource BgField}"
                        BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderCol}" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0">
                    <Grid>
                        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                        </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <StackPanel Grid.Row="0" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="6,4">
                            <Button Content="Clear Log" Click="ClearLogButton_Click" Padding="8,3"/>
                        </StackPanel>
                        <Grid Grid.Row="1">
                            <ListBox x:Name="LogList" Background="Transparent" Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}"
                                     BorderThickness="0" FontFamily="Consolas" FontSize="{DynamicResource UIFontSizeLog}" Padding="6">
                                <ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                                    <DataTemplate>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding DisplayText}" TextWrapping="Wrap">
                                            <TextBlock.Style>
                                                <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource FgText}"/>
                                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Level}" Value="DEBUG">
                                                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#8A97A3"/>
                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Level}" Value="WARNING">
                                                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FFA500"/>
                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Level}" Value="ERROR">
                                                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FF6B6B"/>
                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                                </Style>
                                            </TextBlock.Style>
                                        </TextBlock>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                            </ListBox>
                            <Button x:Name="JumpToBottomButton" Content="Jump to Bottom ▼" Click="JumpToBottomButton_Click"
                                    HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" Margin="0,0,0,10"
                                    Visibility="Collapsed" Background="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}" Foreground="Black" FontWeight="Bold"/>
                        </Grid>
                    </Grid>
                </Border>
            </StackPanel>
        </Border>
    </Grid>
</Window>
